bloques: SmartTEAM blocks: sensors, outputs, motors and screens.
bloques.borrarMensajes: Clears the Morse message and the translated message.
bloques.boton: Returns 1 if the button is pressed and 0 if it is not.
bloques.botonLogico: Compares the button value with a number.
bloques.colorBrillo: Measures the brightness seen by the color sensor (0 to 255).
bloques.guardarMensajeMorse: Starts reading the Morse button on P0: short = dot, long = dash.
bloques.helice: Turns the propeller on or off.
bloques.joystick: Reads the joystick position on the X or Y axis (−100 to 100).
bloques.joystickDetecta: Returns 1 if the joystick points in that direction and 0 if not.
bloques.lcdBorrar: Clears everything on the LCD screen.
bloques.lcdEscribir: Writes text or a number on the LCD screen.
bloques.led: Turns the LED on or off.
bloques.ledIntensidad: Sets the LED brightness: 0 = off, 1023 = maximum.
bloques.mensajeMorse: The message written in dots and dashes.
bloques.motorMulticolor: Spins one motor. Use + to choose the speed (0 to 100).
bloques.movimientoCm: Moves forward or backward the chosen centimeters, then stops.
bloques.movimientoGirar: Turns the robot the chosen degrees, then stops.
bloques.movimientoSimple: Moves the robot at the chosen speed (0 to 100).
bloques.oledBorrar: Clears everything on the OLED screen.
bloques.oledEscribir: Writes text or a number on the OLED screen.
bloques.puertoToAnalogPin: Converts a port to its analog pin.
bloques.puertoToDigitalPin: Converts a port to its digital pin.
bloques.robitApagarLeds: Turns off ROBIT's and the ultrasonic sensor's LEDs.
bloques.robitFrenar: Stops ROBIT (sets the motors to zero).
bloques.robitGirar: ROBIT turns 90° to the left or right.
bloques.robitLedRgb: Turns on ROBIT's and the ultrasonic sensor's LEDs with the chosen color.
bloques.robitMostrarCadena: Shows text on the micro:bit LED matrix, slow or fast.
bloques.robitMover: ROBIT moves forward or backward without stopping (until ROBIT │ Brake).
bloques.robitMovimientoCm: ROBIT moves forward or backward the chosen centimeters (up to 50).
bloques.seguidorAccionCentro: Movement and speed (0 to 100) for this sensor.
bloques.seguidorAccionDerecha: Movement and speed (0 to 100) for this sensor.
bloques.seguidorAccionIzquierda: Movement and speed (0 to 100) for this sensor.
bloques.seguidorDeLinea: Detects whether that side of the follower is on the black line.
bloques.seguidorDeLineaAcciones: Chooses what the robot does when each sensor leaves the line.
bloques.seguidorLinea: Reads one line follower sensor: 1 = black, 0 = white.
bloques.seguidorLineaDetecta: Detects whether the chosen sensor sees black.
bloques.sensorColorDetecta: Detects whether the sensor sees the chosen color.
bloques.sensorGrises: Reads the value of one grayscale sensor (0 to 255).
bloques.sensorGrisesComparar: Compares a grayscale sensor reading with a number.
bloques.servo: Moves the servo to the chosen angle (0 to 180°).
bloques.sueloLogico: Tells whether the soil is dry or wet.
bloques.tiraRgb: Sets the color of each of the 6 LEDs on the strip.
bloques.tiraRgbAjustada: Lights the whole strip with a mix of red, green and blue (0 to 255).
bloques.tiraRgbApagarTodos: Turns off all the LEDs on the strip.
bloques.traducirMensaje: Translates the Morse message into letters.
bloques.ultrasonido: Measures the distance to an object in centimeters (0 to 200).
bloques.ultrasonidoLogico: Detects whether there is an object between 3 and 25 cm away.
bloques.ultrasonidoLogicoHasta: Detects whether an object is at the chosen distance or closer.
bloques.ultrasonidoRgb: ROBIT measures the distance to an object in centimeters (0 to 200).
bloques.ultrasonidoRgbLogico: Detects whether there is an object 3 to 25 cm from ROBIT.
